fields.title: 1. Event Comparison — Press Reports vs Government Statements vs Filings
fields.md:
| Date (local) | Fact | Source grade · source |
|---|---|---|
| 10/13 (Tue) | **Speed limits begin** on Ukrainian military Starlink·Starshield terminals — connection drops on platforms (drones, aircraft) moving faster than 160 km/h (about 100 mph). Reuters 10/23: "The restrictions have been in place since October 13" | ⑤ [Reuters 10/23 (reprinted by TimesLIVE)](https://www.timeslive.co.za/news/world/2026-10-23-ukraine-says-starlink-speed-curbs-remain-despite-trump-assurance/) · ③ Presidential adviser Beskrestnov report 10/14 ([Snopes summary 10/21](https://www.snopes.com/news/2026/10/21/starlink-starshield-slowdown-ukraine/)) |
| 10/14 (Wed) | CEO post on X: "Starshield is owned and controlled by the U.S. government — speed and usage limits are set by the U.S. military and ultimately the president" (**statement**, not a basis for judgment) | [Reuters 10/15 (reprinted by Internazionale)](https://www.internazionale.it/ultime-notizie-reuters/2026/10/16/exclusive-order-to-limit-starshield-for-ukraine-came-from-inside-white-house-sources-say) |
| 10/15 (Thu) | **Reuters exclusive**: two U.S. officials + one Western official — the order to limit Starshield was relayed from **inside the White House** to Defense Department leadership. A senior official: "The president never made such a request." SpaceX and the Defense Department **did not respond** | ⑤ Same as above |
| 10/15–16 | Zelensky (Piers Morgan): "People are dying because of that decision" · The same terminals work above 112 mph in the EU outside the border → **not a technical failure** (president's statement) · Defense Ministry source: connectivity restored while moving but **160 km/h cap maintained** | ③ [Kyiv Post 10/16](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/87219) · [American Legion 10/22](https://www.legion.org/information-center/news/security/2026/october/lawmakers-call-for-investigation-into-source-of-starlink-disruptions-in-ukraine) · [Euromaidan Press 10/16](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/10/16/white-house-ordered-limits-on-ukraines-military-satellite-service-reuters-reports-who-made-the-decision-remains-unclear/) |
| 10/19 (Mon)–22 | House members DeLauro·McCollum letter to the Defense Secretary: demand an investigation into the decision to limit and a report to the Armed Services Committee **within 30 days**. Warren·Fitzpatrick demand accountability | ③ [American Legion 10/22](https://www.legion.org/information-center/news/security/2026/october/lawmakers-call-for-investigation-into-source-of-starlink-disruptions-in-ukraine) |
| 10/21 (Wed)–22 | WSJ: the president called the CEO and asked for the limits to be lifted (reported) · President 10/22: "He turned it back on" | ⑤ [Al Jazeera 10/23 (Reuters·AP)](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/23/trump-says-musk-restored-ukraines-starlink-access-amid-russia-war) |
| 10/23 (Fri) | Ukrainian side says restrictions **still** in place (Beskrestnov · Sienik at the embassy in Washington · five officials and a Defense Ministry source) · President 10/23: "I don't think it's me or Elon" | ⑤ [Reuters 10/23](https://www.timeslive.co.za/news/world/2026-10-23-ukraine-says-starlink-speed-curbs-remain-despite-trump-assurance/) |
| **10/24 (Sat)** | **Official announcement by Ukraine's Defense Ministry (Minister Shmyhal... as stated: Minister Hmara)**: monitoring system recorded Starlink·Starshield speed restoration, **connection stable on equipment above 400 km/h**. Zelensky: "Starlink and Starshield have resumed operating at pre-restriction speeds — restoration began overnight" | ③ [Reuters 10/24 (reprinted by GV Wire)](https://gvwire.com/2026/10/24/starlink-in-ukraine-back-to-normal-after-week-of-throttling/) · [Al Jazeera 10/24](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/24/ukraine-says-starlink-restored-as-attacks-continue-in-russia-and-ukraine) · [NPR/KPBS 10/24](https://www.kpbs.org/news/international/2026/10/24/musk-says-spacex-did-restrict-starlink-as-ukraine-says-the-tech-has-been-restored) |
| 10/24 (Sat) | A few hours after the restoration announcement, CEO post on X: "The Ukrainian military violated Starlink's terms of service by using it on attack drones. **That loophole was closed last week**" · "We only enforced the terms when they were bypassed" (**statement** — content admits the restriction was SpaceX's decision and enforcement, but is not used as a basis for judgment) | [NBC 10/25](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/ukraine/elon-musk-spacex-closed-ukraine-starlink-loophole-limits-hit-drone-rcna605494) · NPR/KPBS 10/24 (above) |
| 10/24–26 | Ukraine's rebuttal: under the registration system introduced in February, mobile platforms can connect **only via Starshield**; commercial Starlink is capped at 70–90 km/h and does not work in Russian territory, so "drone missions with civilian Starlink are technically impossible" (Sternenko · Beskrestnov). One site in Donetsk still had the 160 km/h limit on the morning of 10/24 (CNN) | ③·⑤ [The Record 10/26](https://therecord.media/ukraine-disputes-musk-claims-of-starlink-misuse) · [CNN 10/25 search summary](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/25/europe/starlink-musk-violation-accusations-intl) |
| 10/27 (Tue) | Two reports detected (fakti.bg · Silicon UK "Starlink Services Return To Normal For Ukraine") — the Google News links did not open in this round (no redirect body). Content judged to be a reprint of the 10/24 announcement (**inference** — based on title and date) | ⑥ `data/spacex_watch.json` due item |
| Filings | SpaceX: **no 8-K, no IR press release, no official company statement** (all reports say "SpaceX did not respond"). The latest EDGAR filing is an 8-K from 10/26 (GPU financing lease) | ① [EDGAR filing list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001181412&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=20), accessed 2026-10-27 |

**Confirmed as fact (government announcement + agreement of two or more tier-1 reports)**: ① For about 11 days from 10/13 to 10/24 (formula: 10/24 − 10/13), a speed cap (about 160 km/h) was applied to Ukrainian military Starlink·Starshield terminals ② It was a restriction resulting from a decision, not a technical failure (Ukrainian president's control test outside the border · Reuters report of the order · lifting came right after political contact) ③ On 10/24, speeds were restored to pre-restriction levels (above 400 km/h). **Unconfirmed**: who gave the order (White House vs CEO), which of commercial Starlink and Starshield was restricted and on what basis, and whether the restriction was lifted simultaneously in all areas (source: table above).
